title: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition
provenance: Reported by nunnsy (highball-db#399 and #400, 2026-10-08), Apple M3 Pro, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.10: on engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r21 it crashed before its splash screen (rated 1), and on engine x64-crossover26.3-r19 in DXMT mode with the steam and vcrun2022 recipes it ran (rated 5 of 5 after 3 minutes). Not verified by the maintainer. NachitoTez (highball-db#977, 2026-11-04), Apple M2, macOS 15.8.2, Highball 0.10.23, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28 as entered, then a Wine 11 engine, DXMT, rated 3 of 5: on the Wine 10 engine it crashed at start with an illegal instruction exception, and it ran once the environment was switched to a Wine 11 engine. The reporter pointed to highball-db#399 and #400 as the same finding. trca7 (highball-db#1149, 2026-11-11), Apple M5 Max, macOS 27.2.1, Highball 0.10.26, engine x64-crossover26.3-r19, DXMT, rated 3 of 5 after 42 minutes: with Retina pixels at 100% and the steam, vcrun2022 and corefonts recipes. Steam and the game have to be quit fully after each match, or the Mac runs out of memory.
notes: This game has a native macOS version on Steam, so the Mac Steam app runs it directly without Highball. Through Highball, the Windows build crashed before its splash screen on the Wine 10 engine (r21) and ran on the Wine 11 engine (r19, DXMT) for the same player. No measurement here yet. On an M5 Max with the same Wine 11 engine (r19) it runs out of memory unless Steam and the game are quit after each match (highball-db#1149).

knownIssues.symptom: Crashes before the splash screen on the Wine 10 engine, with an illegal instruction exception in one report
knownIssues.cause: not measured. Seen on an M3 Pro with engine r21 (highball-db#399) and on an M2 with macOS 15.8.2 and engine r28 (highball-db#977)
knownIssues.fix: Play the native Mac version, or use the Wine 11 engine (Advanced, Engine on the environment's page), where it ran.

knownIssues.symptom: Memory use keeps growing during play, until the Mac runs out of memory after a match (reported on an M3 Pro and an M5 Max, Wine 11 engine r19, highball-db#400 and #1149)
knownIssues.cause: not investigated. A Sikarugir report describes the same (Sikarugir-App/Sikarugir#233)
knownIssues.fix: quit Steam and the game fully after each match (highball-db#1149, credit trca7).
